title: States push back on EEOC plan to end workforce demographic reporting
summary: Several state and civil rights groups argue that the federal data collection is a foundational part of identifying discriminatory practices across industries, occupations and regions.

title: After successful DMV pilot, Nebraska expands Tyler Technologies AI tools statewide
summary: The AI assistant generated more than 3,400 referrals to state online services and helped reduce call volume by 20% in some areas, according to Mitch Greenwall, deputy director of the Nebraska DMV.

title: Restoring State and Local Cybersecurity Grant Program tops NASCIO’s congressional priorities for upcoming year
summary: Other NASCIO priorities for Congress include the reauthorization of FirstNet, and the preservation of states’ rights to regulate AI.

title: Cities are giving their AI chatbots a new dimension: geography
summary: By connecting AI assistants to GIS systems, cities are experimenting with chatbots that can provide residents with answers to geographical questions

title: Why better spend visibility matters for state and local governments
summary: How modern spend management can help agencies automate workflows, reduce fraud risk, improve compliance and strengthen oversight of taxpayer dollars.

title: San Jose builds homelessness data dashboard to track city shelter performance
summary: The new tool will track shelter use, length of stay, demographics, people housed, program exits and destinations, exits without notice and participant deaths.

title: States want ‘digital front doors,” but funding and AI-powered fraud are interfering
summary: Though building a “digital front door" has been a priority for state governments, several are facing challenges to consolidating identity management across agencies.

title: Aspen Institute pilots real-time EBT fraud blocking with states
summary: The tool is designed to flag potentially fraudulent purchases and temporarily block transactions, similar to fraud detection systems used by banks and credit card companies.

title: All states and territories secure approvals from NTIA on BEAD final proposals
summary: Illinois became the final state or territory to receive approval from the NTIA for its BEAD final proposal.

title: California launches statewide helpline for same-day opioid treatment
summary: State officials said that CA Bridge Connect is intended to close the gap between traditionally fragmented systems that can often make it difficult for people to find treatment when they are ready to seek it.
